description: Paid: 0.007 RLUSD per call via x402 on XRPL mainnet (xrpl:0), or 0.007 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). Combined record in one call: AI provider health readings (public status pages and incidents), x402 payment readings on the XRP Ledger (payments, payers, merchants) and XRPL server info, plus GitHub, npm and MCP Registry readings for agent tooling. Raw readings first, each with its source and timestamp; gaps are reported, not filled. Cached up to 5 minutes. Without payment this returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object (fresh invoiceId); retry with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] or the payment_signature argument. Unpaid calls cost nothing.

payment_signature.description: Optional. Base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (signed RLUSD or USDC PaymentPayload) for hosts that cannot set _meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements.
